title: Resolution urging Albany to crack down on 'vulture fund' debt buyers
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5623/A.5290, which would close a legal loophole letting creditors known as vulture funds buy distressed foreign government debt and sue to collect its full value. The bill would eliminate the current safe harbor for debt purchases over $500,000 and require creditors to negotiate in good faith when a foreign country's debt has been deemed unsustainable by the International Monetary Fund.
